description.value:
You create up to 10 gallons of drinkable water in an open container, or summon a rain that fills a 30-foot cube and douses open flames within it. Alternatively, you may destroy an equal amount of water in an open container, or clear away a 30-foot cube of fog.

Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, the water created increases by 10 gallons, or the cube's size increases by 5 feet, for each slot level above 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
